_about: Fixes applied to a port model after it loads (world_streamer.gd _apply_port_fixes), keyed by the port .glb's name. Coordinates are the port's own frame (the glb's). clip_colliders: [x_min, z_min, x_max, z_max] the collider's points are pulled inside. move: new position of a node. Remove an entry once the Blender file has the fix and the port is re-exported.

clip_colliders._note: The east tavern's walkable-interior walls were built for a bigger footprint than the tavern shell: they stood up to 1.3 m out from the visible walls (an invisible wall in front of the pub). Clipped to the shell.

move._note: The tables' origins are at one end of the table, so the tankards placed by the origin stood on the cobbles beside them. Moved onto the table tops.
